create_JND_module: create a JND module for just-noticeable-difference watermarking with configurable channels and blue channel weighting
run_JND_heatmaps: run the JND heatmaps method to compute visibility thresholds from input images in [0,1] range
test_jnd_la: test the jnd_la luminance masking method that computes perceptual thresholds for dark and bright regions
test_jnd_cm: test the jnd_cm contrast masking method that computes perceptual thresholds based on image gradient magnitude
run_JND_forward: run the JND forward method to apply visibility-based watermark deltas to input images
